settings.privacySubtitle: How we handle your voice & data
settings.disclaimer: ⚠ STiTy provides AI-generated translations and does not guarantee accuracy. Do not rely on it for medical, legal, or emergency communication.

blocks.text: 1. Voice data
STiTy records your voice through the device microphone only while a session is active. Audio is streamed to our translation servers, transcribed, and translated in real time.
2. What we store
Audio recordings are <bold>not stored</bold> after the session ends.
Translated text transcripts are kept on your device only.
We log anonymized session metadata (duration, languages used) for service quality.
3. Third-party services
We use the following third parties to process audio:
Google Cloud Speech-to-Text
OpenAI / Anthropic translation APIs
Their privacy policies apply to data they process.
4. Your rights
You can delete all data tied to your device at any time via Settings → Delete my data. Contact privacy@stity.app for any request.
5. Children
STiTy is not intended for users under 13.
1. Service description
STiTy is a real-time speech translation tool. Translation quality depends on audio clarity, language pair, and AI model performance.
2. No guarantee
Translations are produced automatically and may be inaccurate. Do not rely on STiTy for medical, legal, financial, or emergency communication.
3. Acceptable use
Do not record people without their consent.
Do not use STiTy to harass, defame, or deceive others.
Do not attempt to reverse-engineer the service.
4. Termination
We may suspend access at any time for policy violations.
